definitions: In Greek mythology, the son of Zeus and Maia, messenger of the gods, god of trade, heraldry, merchants, commerce, roads, sports, travellers, and athletes. His Roman counterpart is Mercury.
A European Space Agency project for a reusable spaceplane, cancelled in 1992.
A high-end fashion brand, particularly known for its leather goods and scarves.
examples: Hermes delivered the message to the other gods.
The Hermes project aimed to provide Europe with independent access to space.
She carried a classic Hermes Birkin bag.
